shortDescription: Manages the Browser Control policy settings

options.name: allow_all_browsers
options.description: If true, allows all browsers and their versions access to the internet.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: blocked_chrome_versions
options.description: Versions of Google Chrome browser that need to be blocked. If not set, all allowed.

options.name: blocked_firefox_versions
options.description: Versions of Mozilla Firefox browser that need to be blocked. If not set, all allowed.

options.name: blocked_internet_explorer_versions
options.description: Versions of Microsoft browser that need to be blocked. If not set, all allowed.

options.name: blocked_opera_versions
options.description: Versions of Opera browser that need to be blocked. If not set, all allowed.

options.name: blocked_safari_versions
options.description: Versions of Apple Safari browser that need to be blocked. If not set, all allowed.

options.name: bypass_all_browsers
options.description: If true, all browsers are bypassed for warnings.

options.name: bypass_applications
options.description: List of applications that need to be bypassed for warnings. Has effect only if enable_warnings is true. If not set, all vulnerable applications are warned.

options.name: bypass_plugins
options.description: List of plugins that need to be bypassed for warnings. Has effect only if enable_warnings is true. If not set, all vulnerable plugins are warned.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: enable_smart_browser_isolation
options.description: If true, Smart Browser Isolation is enabled. When set to true, C(smart_isolation_profile) is required.

options.name: enable_warnings
options.description: If true, warnings are enabled.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: plugin_check_frequency
options.description: Specifies how frequently the service checks browsers and relevant applications to warn users regarding outdated or vulnerable browsers, plugins, and applications. If not set, the warnings are disabled.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: smart_isolation_groups
options.description: List of group IDs for which the Smart Isolation rule is applied.

options.name: smart_isolation_profile
options.description: The browser isolation profile. Provide as a dict with C(id) key (UUID string). Required when C(enable_smart_browser_isolation) is true. Example a dict with C(id) key containing a UUID such as C(161d0907-0a57-4aab-98c2-eccbd651c448).

options.name: smart_isolation_profile_id
options.description: The isolation profile ID (integer).

options.name: smart_isolation_users
options.description: List of user IDs for which the Smart Isolation rule is applied.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
